content.text: The Honest Reality Most Creators Avoid

Most creators in Pakistan are unaware that they don't actually need a Stripe account to sell digital products online. But this is a myth perpetuated by the very platforms that restrict access to these services. In reality, there are countless payment processors and cryptocurrencies that can facilitate international transactions without the need for a Stripe account. However, these alternatives are often hidden from view, and creators are left to navigate the complex world of blockchain payments and infrastructure on their own. This is precisely why the majority of Pakistani creators struggle to sell their digital products online.
Why the Popular Advice Is Wrong

The popular advice to use a PayPal account or a Stripe account to receive payments from international buyers is not only outdated but also woefully inadequate. These platforms are heavily restricted in Pakistan, and creators are often left waiting for days or even weeks for their payments to clear.
